scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,DOCS,WEB "npm --prefix backend run dev" "python3 -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir doc-service --reload --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate
